children: Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL, Financials), the parent company of Waymo, is bringing its robotaxi operation to another overseas country.

Waymo announced Friday that it aims to begin its self-driving ride-hailing service in Toronto in 2028. That would be the first scheduled deployment for the corporation in Canada, another move outside its U.S. base.
Waymo is working with Element Fleet Management on fleet operations as it gets ready for the Toronto launch.
The business also intends to begin mapping the city and collaborate with local officials ahead of the deployment. For Alphabet, it's more than just one city.
Waymo already has commercial robotaxi services in a few US areas and is moving into destinations such as London and Tokyo.
Toronto provides another test of the technology's scalability in varied weather, traffic and regulatory situations.That is what investors need to monitor.
Waymo has spent years showing that autonomous driving is theoretically possible. The next step is to prove the firm can grow city by city without expenditures growing faster than revenues.
The business also intends to create hundreds of jobs over time in maintenance, validation driving and customer service .
The next item to watch for is regulatory progress, and if Toronto is still on pace for the 2028 debut.

title: Waymo Is Taking Robotaxis Into Canada
